documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of Postal_Ballot
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Manorama Industries reported strong Q1 FY27 financial performance with year-on-year revenue growth of 39.5% and crossing the INR 4,000 million quarterly revenue and EBITDA milestone. Management highlighted strategic expansions including a new subsidiary in Chad and land acquisition in Burkina Faso to strengthen sourcing and backward integration. The company maintains an optimistic long-term outlook supported by growing customer partnerships, capacity debottlenecking, and investments in specialty and cocoa butter alternative products. Management also addressed various operational queries regarding capex plans, working capital, and raw material procurement. Manorama Industries Limited reported strong financial performance for FY 2026, driven by significant volume growth, value-added product mix optimization, and capacity expansions.

guidance.claim: The company expects capacity utilization to be around 80% to 85% for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: So we expect our to be around 80%, 85% for full year for this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted sustained demand across end-use industries and deeper customer relationships.
demand_outlook.quote: Our profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year, reflecting sustained demand across the end use industries, deeper customer relationships and the increasing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand continues to be sustained and growing across food and cosmetic sectors worldwide.
demand_outlook.quote: This excellence in performance is a testament to the resilience of our integrated value chain, the global relevance of our specialty fats and coco butter equivalents and the sustained and growing demand we continue to witness across the food and cosmetic sectors worldwide through our scientific and high-tech products, which are being used all over the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, we acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility with regulatory approvals currently in the progress.

capex_expansion.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are being targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans a strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years.
capex_expansion.quote: Through strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years, this investment program spans setting up of a new solvent fractionation manufacturing facility for Sal, Shea, Palm, Mango and other exotic seeds and ESOS.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin expanded by 326 basis points to 19.5% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 67.6% year-on-year, that is INR 79 crores with profit after tax margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for FY 2026 stood at 27.1% on a standalone basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%, reflecting focused product mix optimization and disciplined cost management.

orders_capacity.claim: Debottlenecking activities are expected to add an additional 4,500 tons of fractionation capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So approximately, we are expecting additional 4,500 tons of debottlenecking in this financial year, additionally.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing capacity utilization stands at approximately 85% of 40,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Existing capacity are on a utilization level of 85% of 40,000 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a qualified institutional placement to strengthen its balance sheet and accelerate growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The successful completion of our qualified institutional placement, QIP, marks another important milestone, strengthening our balance sheet and providing the financial flexibility to accelerate growth across manufacturing, sourcing and high value-added segments.

capital_allocation.claim: Total proposed capex investment is planned around INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores in financial year 2027.
capital_allocation.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores for FY 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores, ROCE of 33.6% and ROE of 40.3%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management acknowledged that business involves risks, but stated the company has built a robust model to navigate them.
risks_headwinds.quote: Business is business, business has risk, but Manorama navigates and has built a robust model, and we are looking forward to build it further.

management_commitments.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and refinery capacity are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to spend approximately INR 220 crores more in capex during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Until today, we have spent around INR 70 crores out of our total proposed capex plan, and we intend to spend approximately around INR 220 odd crores more in this financial year for our capex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
